meta.name: Disobedience
meta.description: Disobedienceglances a new phase of civil disobedience movements to stop climate change by profiling some actions that are being taken throughout the world, led by regular people. Civil disobedience and direct action are at the centre of stopping the rich and powerful from destroying the planet—we actually have to stop them.Disobedienceshows that profound shifts are required to deal with the climate crisis. The calling on how to act is up to you.
